column1: # Pieces the 1910 plan draws as buildings that are not buildings, or that were gone by winter 1917-18. Each was checked

# world lane at eye height. build.sh drops the building or public piece that holds each point, and the ground there
# becomes open (courtyard or street by the plan's tint, as any other).
